description: Self leadership is a gift , allow yourself to lead YOURSELF. #selfmastery #selfpresservation #bigsisteradvice
transcript: Self-sufficiency has been one of the greatest gifts that I've learned to build upon. Being self-sufficient has led me to a life where I entertain myself, where I am able to be forward-thinking and solution-oriented, where I am able to think logically and think critically, because I know myself so well, I know what I need, and I know how to provide those things for myself. A self-sufficient life allows me to maneuver without judgment. A self-sufficient life allows me to stay laser-focused and not distracted by the external world.
